summary: Expanded the universe around the grid-services/EPC/labor-capacity chokepoint. The reference anchor remains Quanta Services, but the more relevant Layer 1B discovery lane is specialty electrical and utility contractors where transmission, distribution, substation, power-delivery, MSA backlog, and skilled-field execution capacity may be underappreciated relative to equipment suppliers. The strongest underfollowed candidates for later validation are MYR Group and Primoris; MasTec is less obscure after rerating but still provides a useful second-tier public-market mapping for power delivery and clean-energy infrastructure execution.
